transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Severus! My crystallized pineapple is ruined — that jar was a gift from the Minister himself! And you've used my personal cauldron without asking! I have the Potions Guild inspection in two hours and the storeroom looks like a hippogriff went through it. You promised to keep it tidy!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: I assure you, Horace, I did not misuse your cauldron or mishandle your crystallized pineapple. It seems a rather fortuitous timing that the storeroom has been disrupted just before your inspection. I suggest you calm down and focus on organizing the contents while I investigate the cause of this chaos.

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Fortuitous timing or not, Severus, I have precious little patience left for gallivanting conspiracies when my reputation is on the line! Investigate if you must, but you will help me set this storeroom straight before those inspectors arrive, considering your earlier promise. My goodness, the mess!

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: I understand your predicament, Horace. Let us address the immediate concern. I will aid in sorting the ingredients. However, you must also locate the culprits responsible for this disarray. It is crucial we identify who has violated our shared space to prevent future occurrences. Now, if you would direct me to where the most urgent reorganization is needed?

transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Direct you, indeed! We can start by placing all the powdered moonstone back into proper storage. It's scattered everywhere! Then, address that overturned shelf — the shrivelfigs and billywig stings are all mixed up. transcript.speaker: antagonist
transcript.text: Thank you, Severus, your deft touch with charms is indeed commendable. transcript.speaker: antagonist

transcript.speaker: roleplayer
transcript.text: Understood, Horace. The room is now in pristine condition, and I have taken the liberty of ensuring the temperature is optimal for the crystallized pineapple. transcript.speaker: antagonist
